title: RAW conserved mediators: one inhibitory influence supports retention and expulsion through different paths
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Albertus De anima II.2.VIII supplies named intermediate processes for cold's indirect assistance and direct hindrance. A proposed guarded path constructor preserves intermediate owners and opposite path contributions without inventing an overall therapeutic sign. No Voynich words are assigned.

design.mechanism: Compose explicitly asserted local inhibitory and supporting relations through the SAME written intermediate state; retain the path and its guard in the output. Inhibiting a resource-loss process can support an operation dependent on that resource, while inhibiting its moving instrument can oppose the operation. Neither path establishes a net outcome.
design.unit: The complete owned Albertus De anima II.2.VIII chapter is the historical unit. A future target descendant must cover a complete predeclared native f85r2 block and retain the rest of its chosen source obligations; the two attractive examples alone are not a full chapter reading.
design.contrast: Mediated resource preservation versus unqualified cold-is-beneficial classification; also versus a temporally ordered conservation/release account with the same events but no simultaneous opposed contributions.
design.prediction: One uniform inhibition relation must take a loss process in two resource cases and a motion process in the direct case. The intermediate resource, downstream faculty, owner, context, and guard must connect by written argument identity. Opposite path signs can coexist; a net benefit or harm claim requires additional written content.

source.author_work: Albertus Magnus, De anima, Liber II, Tractatus II, caput VIII
source.scope: Entire chapter, opening enumeration through closing spirit statement. Read complete institutional electronic Latin text on 2026-09-26. Browser line numbering this fetch 24-38 differs from the earlier receipt's 19-34; both are display coordinates, not different chapter boundaries.
source.content: Cold preserves nutrient against heat-induced dissolution and loss of power; it also contains and thickens wind, which expels surplus when strong. Cold separately hinders spirit motion and vital operations. Retention lasts until appropriate alteration. The chapter also covers appetite, attraction, digestion, animal instruments, plant differences, and other aids to expulsion. Its initial list includes appetite, while retention is treated separately: no four-to-four diagram mapping follows.
source.qualification: Historical physiological claims, not current medical advice or established mechanisms. No modern gas pressure, conservation quantity, common clinical episode, or simultaneous action is supplied. No manuscript collation or Upper Rhine circulation claim is added.

new_formal_contract.status: An explicit exploratory semantic construction, not a source-entailed universal causal calculus or an implemented model.
sorts: Case: owner, applicable domain, temporal extent and comparison/background conditions
Condition: an instance of an influencing quality or other circumstance
ProcessAspect: a named process with its arguments and affected aspect
ResourceAspect: a named bearer with the property needed by an operation
OperationAspect: a faculty operation, its owner and criterion of performance

primitive_relations.INHIBITS: Condition x ProcessAspect x Case -> asserted local negative influence
primitive_relations.DEPLETES: ProcessAspect x ResourceAspect x Case -> asserted local negative influence
primitive_relations.SUPPORTS: (ResourceAspect or ProcessAspect) x OperationAspect x Case x Guard -> asserted local positive influence

new_formal_contract.law_preservation: INHIBITS(q,L,k) AND DEPLETES(L,R,k) AND SUPPORTS(R,F,k,g) licenses PATH(q,F,k,g,[L,R],positive). The two L and two R arguments must be identical denotations, not merely members of one word class.
new_formal_contract.law_direct: INHIBITS(q,M,k) AND SUPPORTS(M,F,k,g) licenses PATH(q,F,k,g,[M],negative). The same INHIBITS signature is used; M cannot silently become a resource or a different owner's motion.
new_formal_contract.composition_cost: These laws assume locally monotone directional contributions in one compatible background, solely for composing the represented explanatory claim. A named cause in prose alone does not establish this mathematical assumption. No magnitudes or actual interventions are supplied.
new_formal_contract.guard_rule: Every premise guard is retained conjunctively. Absent proof of g leaves a conditional path; it does not establish NOT g. A missing edge blocks derivation, not the real-world effect.
new_formal_contract.path_output: PATH is an attributed explanatory relation, not an achieved event. Positive and negative paths remain two records indexed by intermediates. They are not summed, canceled, voted on or converted into a net sign.
new_formal_contract.contradiction_rule: Two opposed PATH records are compatible. A genuine same-outcome conflict would require an explicitly asserted positive and negative NET comparison with the same owner, operation, aspect, time, baseline and conditions. No NET statement is assigned here.
new_formal_contract.no_implicit_identity: Sharing Cold as a quality kind does not identify cold instances, bodies, nutrient portions, wind portions, spirit, or surplus. Wind and spirit are not synonyms. A wind-containing surplus may have a part/whole relationship; neither physical disjointness nor identity is silently imposed. Retention of a resource's usable aspect is not total spatial immobility.

finite_cases_and_source_costs.frame: q=cold condition; L=nutrient dissolution/dissipation; R=nutrient's preserved usable aspect; F=retentive operation
finite_cases_and_source_costs.obligation: Write which nutrient, which retainer and which alteration endpoint. Treating preservation of the nutrient's form/power as the ResourceAspect needed by F is an analytical decomposition, not a newly attested technical term or a single-word gloss. It does not prove digestion succeeds.

finite_cases_and_source_costs.frame: q=cold condition; L=wind escape; R=available effective wind; F=expulsion of specified surplus
finite_cases_and_source_costs.obligation: Wind containment and thickening remain separate content. Strong wind is an explicit guard; preservation alone neither implies strength nor successful expulsion. The uniform preservation schema cannot absorb the thickening clause as an invisible step. Other source aids remain owed by a full chapter rendering.

finite_cases_and_source_costs.frame: q=cold condition; M=motion of the operative spirit; F=the explicitly scoped vital operation
finite_cases_and_source_costs.obligation: The source's general instrumental claim is not a free binder for every target event. To join D to R or E, a written construction must identify the same operation owner and applicable case. Applying the generic statement to each named faculty is a declared scope choice.

serious_rivals.account: Cold preserves a resource earlier; its later action occurs in another phase, perhaps after the cold ceases. This can preserve the historical account without simultaneous opposing contributions.
serious_rivals.distinction: Only written temporal scope or continuation can select a common episode/horizon. The source does not entitle this RAW to reject the phased account. No implicit same-time marker is allowed.

serious_rivals.account: A phrase classifies a condition as useful for retention or expulsion while separate clauses describe mechanisms. The candidate marker need not itself encode mediation.
serious_rivals.distinction: Whole written argument reuse must localize the resource path to the proposed constructor. Merely matching both historical helpfulness claims or reproducing their events does not identify the constructor's meaning.

serious_rivals.account: The same concrete events are ordered by a temporal connector, with causal attribution elsewhere or left pragmatic.
serious_rivals.distinction: No unsupported independence null: a temporal account can contain dependent events and identical final outcomes. A difference must concern what causal relation the written construction asserts, not an artificial physical-output difference.

smallest_consequence_and_falsifier.positive_opportunity: A complete reading could reuse the same inhibition construction in R and E, while exposing a different intermediate resource and downstream operation. Joining D would explain why apparently opposing claims need not change the cold word's sense.
smallest_consequence_and_falsifier.minimal_failure: Reject a fixed descendant if repeated syntax identifies L or R in one clause but requires a different referent at the next edge without a written transfer/reference rule; if an E clause drops its strength/thickening content; or if the constructor converts the conditional contribution into an achieved or net result.
smallest_consequence_and_falsifier.decision_change: Retain for full authoring only if two complete cases can be written with the SAME construction and owned intermediates. If only helpful/harmful predicate tags can be allocated, this has no gain over532/343 and should remain an unbound source graph.
smallest_consequence_and_falsifier.not_a_test_yet: No target constructor is assigned, no empirical output predicted from target text, no semantic executor or target query run. A working reading may be explored without confirmed words, but formal consequences of guessed inputs alone are not confirmation.
